name: omega-value-layer
purpose: Trust-first orientation contract for purpose, proof state, next action and adjacent value without fabricated activity, scarcity, social proof or financial outcomes.
principles: No fabricated activity, balances, rankings or scarcity
Financial information is descriptive and evidence-bound
Every service has a visible route back to the wider platform

default.purpose: Navigate the Omega platform, understand what is available, and choose a meaningful next step.
default.value: A single entry point into the nine-realm platform.
default.commercial: No purchase required to explore public information.

dashboard.purpose: Your command bridge: see what matters, find your next useful action and reach every realm.
dashboard.value: A single starting point instead of disconnected dashboards.
dashboard.proof: LIVE — platform shell; personalized data is shown only when available.
dashboard.commercial: Explore first; paid services or membership are shown only where configured.

gateway.purpose: Understand access, authentication and the route into the governed platform.
gateway.value: A transparent entry point that explains what happens before access is granted.
gateway.commercial: Access is not represented as purchased unless a real transaction exists.

services.purpose: Compare the platform's services by purpose, evidence state and route to action.
services.value: Find a concrete service instead of navigating a catalogue blindly.
services.proof: LIVE — service catalogue; individual availability is state-labelled.
services.commercial: Pricing and purchase are shown only from authoritative configured sources.

consultancy.purpose: Submit a governed consultancy intake with confidentiality acceptance.
consultancy.value: Turn a question or project into a structured professional request.
consultancy.proof: LIVE — authenticated intake boundary; no request is fabricated.
consultancy.commercial: Commercial terms are presented before any real charge.

investment.purpose: Review investment research, watchlists and simulations without confusing research with financial advice or execution.
investment.value: Separate research, simulation and real financial state so decisions remain informed.
investment.proof: CALCULATED/SIMULATED where applicable; live balances and execution require authoritative provider evidence.
investment.commercial: No investment outcome is promised; execution requires a real authorized provider path.

portfolio.purpose: Review portfolio information that is actually available to the authenticated member.
portfolio.value: One view of holdings and related evidence without synthetic balances.
portfolio.proof: LIVE when provider/member data exists; otherwise UNAVAILABLE/PARTIAL.

evidence.purpose: Inspect the evidence behind platform events, tasks and governed actions.
evidence.value: Trace important platform state back to observable evidence.

academy.purpose: Learn through structured content and demonstrated progression.
academy.value: Turn time spent learning into durable, evidence-bound progress.
academy.proof: LIVE — course and progression surfaces; completion is recorded only after a real action.
academy.commercial: Course or membership charges are shown only when configured.

agents.purpose: Understand the twelve governed agents, their roles and their permitted boundaries.
agents.proof: LIVE — registry and policy; execution requires the governed runtime boundary.
agents.commercial: AI capability does not imply autonomous financial execution.

intelligence.purpose: Research and inspect evidence-backed intelligence across the platform.
intelligence.value: Move from information to traceable understanding.
intelligence.proof: LIVE/PARTIAL according to available evidence and providers.
intelligence.commercial: External provider costs, if any, must be disclosed before use.

privacy.purpose: Control consent, export and deletion of your platform data.
privacy.value: Sovereignty includes the ability to inspect, export and erase your data.
privacy.proof: LIVE — privacy controls and versioned documents.
privacy.commercial: No charge for exercising core privacy controls.
